title: Where the null is imposed matters: surrogate inference after thresholding and temporal aggregation - reproducibility package
description: Fixed protocols, analysis scripts, row-level and summary outputs, independent-code audit, CMIP6 Amazon reconstruction workflow, figure source data, and final figure-generation scripts supporting a methodological study of surrogate-null placement before versus after thresholding and temporal aggregation.
